title: The Meeting Before Zama
setting: Open ground between two camps on the plain near Zama, in Africa. Both armies are drawn up and can see them. Each general has brought one interpreter and nothing else. Polybius says they stood for a moment in silence before either spoke.
stakes: Whether the sixteen-year war ends here in terms, or tomorrow in a battle that will destroy one of them.

roles_in_scene.hannibal: Recalled from Italy after sixteen years, undefeated in the field and out of options, asking for terms
roles_in_scene.scipio-africanus: Holding every advantage, with a Numidian cavalry force that has just arrived, and no reason to concede anything

ground_truth: Hannibal opens by invoking the reversals of fortune and the wisdom of settling while both can still choose
He offers Carthage's surrender of Spain, Sicily and the islands - the situation before the war
Scipio answers that Carthage broke the previous armistice and that these terms cost her nothing she still holds
Scipio demands the original terms plus reparation for the truce Carthage violated
The conference breaks up without agreement
Battle is joined the next day and Hannibal is defeated
opening_line: Two armies watch from either side of an empty plain. The two men who have spent their lives studying each other meet for the first time.
